nodes_add.name: N.K.V. Krishna & Preetha Krishna (Ekam)
nodes_add.note: Son and daughter-in-law of Kalki Bhagavan and Amma; took over the Oneness organisation and its businesses c. 2017; opened Ekam at Varadaiahpalem, January 2018.

nodes_add.name: Kailasa (self-declared)
nodes_add.note: Declared by Nithyananda in December 2019 as a sovereign Hindu nation 'without borders'; recognised by no government or international body.

nodes_add.name: Jagadguru Rambhadracharya
nodes_add.note: Ramanandi scholar-monk of Chitrakoot; guru of Dhirendra Krishna Shastri.

nodes_add.name: Sannyasi Baba (Bageshwar Dham)
nodes_add.note: Ancestor of Dhirendra Krishna Shastri whom the family names as founder of the Bageshwar Dham shrine at Gada.

nodes_update.name: Kalki Bhagavan & Amma Bhagavan (Oneness)
nodes_update.note: Vijay Kumar Naidu, born Natham, Tamil Nadu, 7 March 1949; died Chennai 29 September 2026; cremated at Ekam Kshetra, Battalavallam, with police honours, early October 2026. With his wife Padmavathi (b. 1954) founded Jeevashram (1984), Satyaloka (1994) and Oneness University, Varadaiahpalem (2000); the deeksha or Oneness Blessing.

nodes_update.name: Nithyananda (Kailasa)
nodes_update.note: Born Arunachalam Rajasekaran, Tiruvannamalai, 1 January 1978 (1977 in some accounts); founded Nithyananda Dhyanapeetam, Bidadi (2003); charged (2018) in a 2010 rape case pending at Ramanagara; bail cancelled 2020; left India 2019; declared Kailasa December 2019.

nodes_update.name: Dhirendra Krishna Shastri (Bageshwar Dham)
nodes_update.note: Born Dhirendra Krishna Garg, Gada, Chhatarpur district, 4 July 1996; head of the Bageshwar Dham Hanuman shrine; known for the divya darbar and Hindu Rashtra campaigning.

edges_upsert.note: Son and daughter-in-law; organisation and business interests handed over c. 2017, renamed Ekam.

Wikipedia says a childhood friend, R. Sankar, introduced him to Krishnamurti's philosophy; a former disciple (Open, 2019) judged the movement against Krishnamurti's teachings. Not in the movement's own timeline (WRSP).
Teaching that suffering comes from the separate self and that awakening ends it.
Reportedly joined the Ramakrishna Math, Chennai, in 1995 (Quartz, citing his own account).
Named 293rd head of the Madurai Aadheenam in 2012; appointment withdrawn the same year. Agamic Shaiva worship in his temples.
Shastri describes himself as Rambhadracharya's disciple (Wikipedia; widely reported).
Ancestor and founder of the shrine; Shastri credits his powers partly to Sannyasi Baba's blessing.

places.name: Oneness University / Ekam, Varadaiahpalem

places.name: Nithyananda Dhyanapeetam, Bidadi

glossary.def: In the Oneness movement, a blessing given by placing the hands on the head, which the movement says transmits energy and starts a process of awakening.
One, oneness. The name of the meditation hall opened at the Oneness campus in 2018 and of the organisation after 2017.
A Tamil Shaiva monastery headed by a pontiff, such as the Madurai Aadheenam.
Mount Kailash, Shiva's abode; also the name Nithyananda gave to his self-declared Hindu nation in 2019.
Divine court: Dhirendra Shastri's public sessions where he says he names visitors' troubles and offers remedies.
A slip of paper on which Dhirendra Shastri writes what he says is a visitor's problem.
A sermon in which a preacher sings and explains a sacred story, such as the Ramcharitmanas, over several days.
Hindu nation: the demand that India be declared a Hindu state.
Homecoming: ceremonies that bring converts to other religions back to Hinduism.
The head of a religious seat or shrine.

nithyananda.mdx: Status of the Gujarat FIR (2019) after November 2019 not found: no chargesheet or trial seen. Interpol notice is disputed (Interpol denied a blue corner notice per TNM) and is left out.
nithyananda.mdx: The latest status of the Ramanagara trial after 2022 was not found; text says pending. Check for any 2024-2026 orders (e.g. proclamation, split of trial).
nithyananda.mdx: MEA wording on his passport is from The Wire's headline only.

dhirendra-shastri.mdx: The Tukaram withdrawal is supported only by search-result headlines (ETV Bharat Feb 2023; IANS Nov 2023, possibly a second remark); not fetched.

kalki-bhagavan: Born 7 Mar 1949 Natham; father Varadarajulu, railways; Madras 1955; Don Bosco; DG Vaishnav maths; LIC clerk; married 9 June 1977; Jeevashram 1984; Satyaloka 1994; deeksha as energy transmission, no initiation needed, collective DNA; 'Kalki is not one person but a collective awakening'; 2002 PIL dismissed; 2017 handover to NKV Krishna and Preetha, renamed Ekam; ~Rs 93 crore seized; died 29 Sep 2026 Chennai aged 77 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kalki_Bhagawan

Timeline: Padmavati b. 15 Aug 1954 Sangam; 1989 courses; Order of Dasas; 1999 land Varadaiahpalem; 2000 Oneness University; 2004 21-day process and trainers; Oneness Temple 22 Apr 2008; 21 Dec 2012 golden age; 2013 mission complete; Jan 2018 Ekam -> https://wrldrels.org/?p=14748

Died Tuesday in Chennai hospital, age-related complications; body to Ekam Kshetra, Battalavallam; Kalki as tenth incarnation of Vishnu -> https://www.deccanchronicle.com/nation/spiritual-guru-kalki-bhagavan-passes-away-in-chennai-1991772

Age 77; born 7 March 1949; DG Vaishnav; LIC clerk -> https://www.thehansindia.com/news/cities/chennai/kalki-bhagavan-dies-at-77-spiritual-leader-and-founder-of-oneness-movement-passes-away-in-chennai-1127245

Deeksha hands on crown; 'a powerful transmission of energy, which rapidly accelerates the evolution of consciousness' (Ardagh, 6 Feb 2008) -> https://www.yogajournal.com/meditation/deeksha-the-oneness-blessing/?scope=anon

'We do not transfer enlightenment. We transfer an initiation into an enlightenment process.'; Opitz parietal/frontal lobes explanation -> https://www.taipeitimes.com/News/feat/archives/2005/04/10/2003249963

Darshan fees, donation targets, unreceipted gifts; 'the organisation was growing so big that the original purpose of spirituality was lost'; Krishnamurti remark; family as minor gods; couple live modestly -> https://openthemagazine.com/features/the-cult-of-kalki-bhagavan/

PTI: searches Wednesday at Varadaiahpalem, Chennai, Bengaluru; 'has been regularly suppressing its receipts at its various centres or ashrams'; Rs 409 crore from FY 2014-15; guru not named -> https://www.business-standard.com/amp/article/pti-stories/raids-lead-to-rs-409-crore-unaccounted-cash-receipts-tax-dept-119101801096_1.html
Rs 43.9 crore cash, Rs 18 crore USD, 88 kg gold Rs 26 crore; 40+ premises; Rs 500 crore evasion per sources -> https://deccanherald.com/india/godman-kalki-evaded-tax-of-rs-500-crore-i-t-769361.html

40 properties incl. Hyderabad; 1,271 carats diamonds; ED FEMA case; Krishna questioned; manager 'nothing to tell the media'; name Kalki c. 1989 -> https://www.theweek.in/theweek/current/2019/11/09/mystic-and-the-moolah.html

'Firstly, we have not fled the country nor have we gone anywhere.'; at Nemam, Thiruvallur; activities at Nemam, Satyaloka, Ekam continuing -> https://thenewsminute.com/article/have-not-fled-country-self-styled-godman-kalki-after-i-t-raids-him-110963
nithyananda: Born Rajasekaran 1 Jan 1978 Tiruvannamalai; mechanical engineer per website; Ramakrishna Math Chennai 1995; Dhyanapeetam Bidadi 2003; claims of healing, animals talking; video claimed morphed -> https://qz.com/india/1754015/nithyananda-sermons-sex-scandals-social-media-and-child-abuse
1977 or 1978; Life Bliss Foundation 2006; Sun TV 2 Mar 2010; Madurai Aadheenam 293rd pontiff 2012 and removal; Mahamandaleshwar Feb 2013; left India Nov 2019 -> https://wrldrels.org/?p=21716
